name: Can I live in my home during a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: Can I live in my home during a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is often possible to live in your home during a kitchen remodel, but it requires careful planning and realistic expectations. The kitchen will be a construction zone, often without functioning appliances, sink, or cooking facilities for periods. We aim to minimize disruption by setting up temporary cooking areas, sealing off dust, and maintaining a clean work environment. Discussing temporary living arrangements, such as using a different area for food preparation, is an important preparation step.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can live in your home during a kitchen remodel, but expect disruption and plan for temporary cooking facilities.
